previewText: Gwinnett and Forsyth County market snapshot for August 2026, Try the Refrigerator Door Dollar-Bill Test and Gwinnett County Fair, and a short note from Danny.

paragraphs: We are halfway through September, and this is usually when I start noticing the first small signs that fall is not too far away.
This week I included one quick kitchen-appliance check you can do in seconds, the upcoming Gwinnett County Fair, and a fresh look at the latest Gwinnett and Forsyth County market numbers.

market.title: Gwinnett and Forsyth County market snapshot for August 2026
market.source: Realtor.com Economic Research county inventory data
paragraphs: For the Wednesday, September 16, 2026 update, Realtor.com shows 3,828 active listings in Gwinnett County for August 2026, 11.4% higher from one year earlier. The median listing price was $450,000, with a median market time of 54 days, 5.9% higher year over year.

For the Wednesday, September 16, 2026 update, Realtor.com shows 1,386 active listings in Forsyth County for August 2026, 11.7% higher from one year earlier. The median listing price was $669,945, with a median market time of 56 days, 9.8% higher year over year.

The practical takeaway for this Wednesday, September 16, 2026 issue is to judge a home against its closest current competition. Countywide figures provide context, but condition, pricing, and the activity in a specific neighborhood still shape the result.
market.verificationNote: Source: Realtor.com Economic Research county inventory data for August 2026. Verified counties available to this run: Gwinnett County, Barrow County, Walton County, Rockdale County, DeKalb County, Jackson County, Forsyth County.

rotatingFeatures.label: HOMEOWNER / SEASONAL HOME TIP
rotatingFeatures.title: Try the Refrigerator Door Dollar-Bill Test
paragraphs: A refrigerator door gasket should hold a firm seal. Close the door gently on the edge of a dollar bill, then pull. If the bill slides out very easily, UGA Extension says it may be time to replace the gasket.
items: Try the check at several spots around the door because one section can wear before another.
Wipe crumbs and residue from the gasket and the surface it meets.
If the seal remains loose or damaged, use the appliance manufacturer's replacement guidance or call a qualified service professional.
rotatingFeatures.closing: It is a tiny test, but it can reveal a worn seal before it becomes an easy-to-miss everyday problem.
rotatingFeatures.source: UGA Cooperative Extension, Home Maintenance Checklist

rotatingFeatures.label: LOCAL COMMUNITY EVENT
rotatingFeatures.title: Gwinnett County Fair
paragraphs: The Gwinnett County Fair returns to the Gwinnett County Fairgrounds with carnival rides, livestock shows, ground acts, concerts, pageants, and other fair traditions.
Daily hours, admission, and special-event times vary, so check the official schedule before heading out.
rotatingFeatures.closing: Gwinnett County Fairgrounds, 2405 Sugarloaf Parkway, Lawrenceville.
rotatingFeatures.source: Gwinnett County Fair official event schedule
